notes:
Original locator p. 3 differs from this publisher PDF: Experiment 1 methods/results are on PDF p. 2, printed p. 1015. Replication Experiment 2 reports final N = 111 after two exclusions, but Participants and Table 3 print condition counts n = 54 and n = 66, which conflict with the final total. Retained the explicitly stated final N, supported by t(109), without correcting group counts. Requested t statistic retained; Table 3 additionally prints d = 0.05.
Completion source review (n_r): Explicit final sample after two specified exclusions is 111 and links to the primary Experiment 2 comparison. Preserve printed final sample and flag contradictory group counts; no N inferred from df.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Requested test statistic is printed for the primary Experiment 2 golf-performance comparison. Preserve t; no effect-size conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact p = .80 accompanies this same primary golf-performance t test, distinct from manipulation checks and exploratory subsets.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly characterize Experiment 2 as a failure to replicate; this is narrative evidence rather than inference from significance.
